## Citation

To cite this package in publications, please use:

Betebenner DW, Van Iwaarden AR, Domingue B (2026). _SGPdata: Exemplar Data Sets for Student Growth
Percentiles (SGP) Analyses._. R package version 29.0-0.0, <https://centerforassessment.github.io/SGPdata/>.

A BibTeX entry:

```bibtex
@Manual{,
  title = {{SGPdata}: Exemplar Data Sets for Student Growth Percentiles (SGP) Analyses.},
  author = {Damian W. Betebenner and Adam R. {Van Iwaarden} and Benjamin Domingue},
  year = {2026},
  note = {R package version 29.0-0.0},
  url = {https://centerforassessment.github.io/SGPdata/},
}
```
